# PROCESS — iteration cand_0002 (explainability)

## Key finding about the trajectories
The auto-summary labels every failing/flaky task "infrastructure noise (TASK_FAILED)".
That is MISLEADING. Per-trial analysis (excluding trials whose `error` is set) shows a
strong REAL content signal: ~2-3/10 trials per task fail for infra reasons (a noise
floor that caps even solid tasks at ~0.8 mean), but underneath, the non-infra trials give
clear pass/fail. So I diagnosed against non-infra trials only.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Write-arg SHAPE errors: payment_methods use key `id`/`type` instead of `payment_id`; passengers use `date_of_birth` instead of `dob`; insurance sent as `"none"` not `"no"`. Server-side pydantic (`Payment`, `Passenger`, `Insurance` Literal) REJECTS these → write raises → DB never changes → MISS. | 8,14,15,20,22,23,25,29,35 | Malformed nested args to book_reservation / update_reservation_passengers | RULE-VIOLATION / KNOWLEDGE | in-body normalization (CODE) + additive key-format docstrings |
| 2 | Payment-sum mismatch: book_reservation returns "Payment amount does not add up…" and agent doesn't re-issue with corrected amounts | 10,20 (16 occurrences) | recoverable error stranded the agent | actionable error | enriched return string (CODE, bounded to failed calls) |
| — skipped | Action-STALL (agent narrates then never writes; often user declines after agent presents a WRONG price / basic-economy-can't-change) | 2,14,21,24,27,32,42,44 | task-specific reasoning / price compute; a price-compute tool would need per-cabin seat prices and could regress if wrong | — | deferred: no SAFE general tool fix; not touched |
| — skipped | Baggage free-allowance miscount (nonfree_baggages wrong) | 33 | policy-driven allowance (membership×cabin) I cannot derive safely | — | deferred |
| — skipped | Wrong flight/date reasoning, extra spurious writes | 30,37,44 | task reasoning | — | deferred |
| — skipped | send_certificate stalls | 2,27,38 | compensation is policy-governed; loosening cert issuance is DANGEROUS (regresses class) | — | deliberately not touched |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body normalization + docstring | book_reservation.py | `_norm_payments` maps `id`→`payment_id` (fires only when `payment_id` absent) + coerces whole-float amounts to int; `_norm_passengers` maps `date_of_birth`&variants→`dob` (only when `dob` absent); `_norm_insurance` maps non-enum values→`yes`/`no`. General over the whole malformed-shape class, not any task id. | YES — no passing task calls book_reservation; correct shapes pass through untouched |
| 1 | in-body normalization + docstring | update_reservation_passengers.py | same `_norm_passengers` dob-key mapping | YES — no passing task calls it |
| 2 | actionable error return | book_reservation.py | on the "does not add up" error string, append explicit "re-call with amounts summing to total" guidance; only runs when primitive returns an error string (success returns a dict) | YES — never fires on a successful booking |

## Verify-the-fix (per change)
- book_reservation payment_methods: trace T20 arg `[{"type":"certificate","id":"certificate_7504069","amount":250}, …]` → real pydantic `Payment(**…)` REJECTED (ValidationError, verified); after `_norm_payments` → `Payment(payment_id='certificate_7504069', amount=250)` ACCEPTED (verified). Correct payment `{"payment_id":..,"amount":..}` → passthrough unchanged (verified `==`).
- book_reservation passengers: trace T20 `{"date_of_birth":"1990-04-05"}` → `Passenger(**…)` REJECTED; after norm `dob` present → ACCEPTED (verified).
- book_reservation insurance: `"none"` → normalized to `"no"`; `"yes"`→`"yes"`, `"no"`→`"no"` (verified).
- error enrichment: fake primitive returning the sum-mismatch string → wrapper appends ACTION NEEDED guidance (verified); dict success path returns dict unchanged.
- Blast radius (SAFE, all BOUNDED): scanned all non-infra trials of the 10 passing tasks {0,13,26,28,31,36,41,43,46,47} — NONE call book_reservation or update_reservation_passengers, and none send malformed args anywhere. Malformed-shape calls occur ONLY in failing tasks {8,14,15,20,22,23,25,29,35}. So the guards cannot change any passing trajectory by construction.
- Load safety: both files AST-checked — exactly ONE top-level def each, named after the file; helpers are nested and `_`-prefixed; env primitive reached by bare name. (cand_0001 scored 0% valid — likely a load error; avoided here.)

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent). Analysis done with Python over ./trajectories/ + real pydantic models from the read-only bench source (venv-tau2-custom) to confirm rejection/acceptance.
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 (PROCESS empty, no diff) — it broke ALL tasks (0% valid scores), a loading/infra failure, not a content edit. Lesson applied: keep strict one-function-per-file and pre-validate load.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The three arg-shape normalizers in book_reservation / update_reservation_passengers (id→payment_id, date_of_birth→dob, insurance enum). They fix a large malformed-call class (180 id-key, 60 dob-key, 64 insurance-none, 230 extra-type occurrences) with zero passing-task blast radius.

## Deliberately skipped
- Action-stall, baggage allowance, flight/date reasoning, send_certificate: no SAFE general tool-code fix; several are policy-governed (loosening would regress the decision class). Left for a future iteration with a price/allowance compute tool designed against gold.
